_comment: Copied to ~/.claude/usage-stats/config.json on install; edit that copy. billing_day: day of month your subscription renews. tz: hours from UTC for cutting days (omit = this PC's zone). rules: [regex on the lowercased cwd with forward slashes, project name]; first match wins, unmatched folders are grouped by their last path segment. extra_roots: more folders holding Claude Code projects/ transcripts.
